grammarFocus: have to / must / can；一般现在时与过去时对比。
title: A Busy Week at Work
instructions: 这是一份模拟听力练习，不是官方雅思考试。请先听录音（或阅读录音原文），然后回答问题。题目类型包括单选题和填空题。填空题答案必须来自原文，且不超过规定字数。所有解释均为中文。
transcript:
M: Hi Lisa, how was your week?
W: Busy! I had to finish a big report by Friday. I worked late every day.
M: That sounds hard. Do you have to work late often?
W: No, usually I finish at 5.30. But this week was different. My manager gave me the report on Monday, and I had to check all the numbers.
M: Did you make any mistakes?
W: Yes, I made one small mistake. I corrected it on Wednesday.
M: Good. Can you take a break now?
W: Not yet. I must send the report to my manager today. Then I can relax.
M: What time will you finish?
W: I have to stay until 6 today. But tomorrow I can leave early.
M: Great. Do you have to work this weekend?
W: No, I don't. I can do what I want. Maybe I'll go to the park.
M: That sounds nice. I have to work on Saturday morning.
W: Oh no! Why?
M: I must help a new colleague. She started on Monday.
W: Well, good luck. I can meet you on Sunday if you want.
M: Yes, let's meet at 2 pm.
W: Perfect. See you then.

grammar.title: have to / must / can 与一般现在时和过去时对比
grammar.explanation: have to 和 must 都表示“必须”，但 have to 更强调客观需要，must 更强调主观义务。can 表示“可以”或“能够”。一般现在时表示经常性动作或状态，过去时表示过去发生的动作。例如：I have to work late today.（今天必须工作到很晚。）I had to finish a report by Friday.（周五前必须完成报告。）
grammar.example: I had to finish a big report by Friday.

questions.explanation: must 后面直接跟动词原形，不加 to。所以 'I must go now.' 正确。
questions.evidence: I must send the report to my manager today.

questions.explanation: 主语是第三人称单数 she，have to 要变成 has to，后面动词用原形。所以 'She has to work late.' 正确。
questions.evidence: I have to stay until 6 today.

options: Yesterday I have to work late.
Yesterday I had to work late.
answers: Yesterday I had to work late.
questions.explanation: yesterday 表示过去，have to 要变成 had to。所以 'Yesterday I had to work late.' 正确。
questions.evidence: I had to finish a big report by Friday.

questions.explanation: can 后面跟动词原形，所以 'Can you help me?' 正确。
questions.evidence: Can you take a break now?
